markers.reading: Wellby sees the woody knot near Canopy’s roots and vines actively defending it.

evidence.quote: DM: So you notice 2 things. One is that, so it's hard to see in these writhing vines, but as you're just watching, like, there's something hard and solid beneath the massive vines right near the roots of this giant tree, like big, like, 10 foot by 10 foot. It looks like, you know, some sort of woody, merged bit of—it's like the—it's like, it's like if you just compressed a whole bunch of trees and plants into this, like almost like, what is that word for, like, fake wood, right, like the particle board, or whatever, but made out of like all sorts of living things into this writhing knot, almost like a tumor. But the vines keep crawling over it, on top of it, almost like they're trying to pile up around it around this like hard knot.

DM: The other thing, though, is, when Wellby, I mean, you can see, like, when you're a few 100 feet away, that, like, there's like vines that are lashing out, like striking at things flying out from the center of this, like, there's at least some part of this tangled mass that seems to be actively defending or—

markers.reading: Wellby approaches the thicker vines, is struck and pulled in, then escapes the restraint and disengages out of reach.

evidence.quote: Wellby: I am going to get closer and closer until it tries to attack me. That seems like the way to figure out the minimum distance.
DM: Not when you get attacked. When a creature ends its turn— reaction, you're actually not grappled, you're just pulled into the vines.
Seeker: Yeah. And it was at a range of 30 feet? Is that when, when it happened?

route.reading: Reaches about 30 feet from the thicker vines, is pulled into them.
Escapes and flies out of reach, not a confirmed return aboard ship.

markers.reading: Wellby flies above grabbing range for a rope test, then releases the rope when the vines pull it.

evidence.quote: Wellby: You know, I'll fly up out of range of them reaching me personally, and then just, like, drop a rope down and dangle it and, like, bonk the rope on the vines, like, does it try to grab it or let it go?

markers.note: He is outside personal reach; the test does not place him back inside the knot or aboard the ship.
